look.title: Pick a look
look.sub: Three looks for «{{cat}}». You can change the menu, layout and colour later.
look.subAny: Three looks to start from. You can change all of it later.
look.moreSub: Every look is drawn with your colour.

editor.previewCaption: A sketch of the store in its own colour.
editor.statusDefaultSub: Nothing published yet: buyers see the default design.
editor.statusOffSub: While the design system is off, buyers see the default design.
editor.statusDraftSub: Buyers still see the old design.
editor.statusUnsaved: Not saved yet: save the draft, then publish it.
editor.disabled: The design system is off on this platform. You can save a draft, but it can't be published until the system is back on.
editor.ownerOnly: Only the store owner can change the design.
editor.saveHint: Saved as a draft: buyers won't see it until you publish.
editor.saved: Draft saved. Buyers don't see it yet.
editor.published: Published: buyers see the new design.
editor.deleted: Draft deleted. The store keeps its published design.
editor.publishBody: Buyers on {{host}} will see the new design straight away.
editor.deleteBody_one: {{count}} change will be lost. The store keeps its published design.
editor.deleteBody_other: {{count}} changes will be lost. The store keeps its published design.
editor.deleteBodySame: The draft matches the published design, so nothing in the store changes.

err.DESIGN_NO_DRAFT: There's no saved draft to publish any more. Save it again.
err.DESIGN_DISABLED: The design system is off on this platform, so nothing can be published.
err.DESIGN_TOO_LARGE: This design is too large to save.
err.DESIGN_INVALID: The server didn't accept this design.
err.forbidden: Only the store owner can change the design.
err.network: Couldn't reach the server. Check the connection and try again.

show.labelsHint: The words beside the icons in the bottom menu.
show.priceHint: On product cards. The product page and the bag always show the price.
show.badgeHint: On products added in the last 14 days.
show.tickHint: Shows once esy verifies the store.
show.socialsHint: The store's contact buttons. The About page always lists the contacts.

banner.title: Banner heading
banner.subtitle: Subtitle
banner.productHint: Optional. Its photo shows on the banner, and the button opens it.
banner.missing: This product is no longer in the store.
banner.needsTitle: The banner shows once it has a heading.

cover.title: Cover
cover.none: You haven't uploaded a cover yet, so a band in the store's colour shows in its place.
cover.drop: Drop a photo or choose one
cover.types: JPEG, PNG, WEBP or GIF · up to 5 MB
cover.live: Saved straight away, not in the draft. Buyers see it when the published design has Cover as its header.
cover.badType: Only JPEG, PNG, WEBP or GIF photos.
